name: skillshare/yii-sentry
description: Sentry component and LogRoute for Yii1

scripts.lint:php: find . -path ./vendor -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P16 php -l -n | (! grep -vF "No syntax errors detected" )

scripts-descriptions.analyze: Performs all static analysis check on PHP code.
scripts-descriptions.analyze:clear-cache: Deletes the PHPStan and Psalm caches.
scripts-descriptions.analyze:phpstan: Performs static analysis checks with PHPStan
scripts-descriptions.analyze:psalm: Performs static analysis checks with Psalm
scripts-descriptions.lint: Checks all source code for linting errors.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fixes all fixable code style errors according to PHPCS.
scripts-descriptions.lint:php: Checks all source code for PHP syntax errors.
scripts-descriptions.lint:phpcs: Checks all source code for code style errors according to PHPCS.
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the full unit and integration test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Runs linting and unit and integration tests.
